Examining sse_hub.go to identify server-side delivery filtering that enforces memo viewing permissions.

ListMemoRelations does not verify access to the parent memo. It only filters related memos. This may be a gap. It is excluded from confirmed enforcement sites.

ListMemoRelations fetches the parent memo by UID without verifying access first. It then applies MemoFilter only to the other memo in each relation. This means relation snippets for both endpoints may leak even when the filter hides the parent memo.

convertMemoRelationFromStore loads full memo content for relation snippets. A user requesting relations for a private memo they do not own could still see those snippets. They would learn the private memo exists and has relations. The store layer's MemoFilter logic still needs review.

Confirmed enforcement sites for memo viewing permissions:

- `checkMemoReadAccess` in `memo_service.go` — the shared helper that performs actual enforcement logic.
- `GetMemo` — invokes `checkMemoReadAccess`.
- `ListMemoComments` — invokes `checkMemoReadAccess` and applies `memoFilter` on comments.
- `ListMemos` — applies query-level filtering via `VisibilityList` and a CEL expression.
- `CreateMemoComment` — performs only an inline private-memo check; it does not enforce full read access.

ListMemoReactions and ListMemoAttachments rely on inline visibility checks rather than the shared helper. UpsertMemoReaction uses a weaker inline private-only check. GetAttachment calls the checkAttachmentAccess helper to enforce linked memo visibility. checkAttachmentPermission provides separate HTTP enforcement with share token support and is invoked from the file serve handler.

GetMemoByShare bypasses normal visibility checks through valid share tokens. This grants view access rather than enforcing it.

canViewerAccessMemo filters notification payloads for comments and email content.

batchConvertMemoRelations applies memoFilter during relation list conversions.

ListAllUserStats and GetUserStats apply VisibilityList filtering on memo queries.

getSitemapXML and GetExploreRSS are public-only endpoints. sse_hub.go enforces server-side delivery filtering via canReceive. memo_mention_helpers restricts who receives mention notifications. Runner and webhook surfaces are being checked for additional enforcement sites.
